tools.name: CreateEvent
tools.description: Create a new football event/festival with venue, dates, capacity, and pitch availability

name.description: Name of the football event (e.g., 'Gauteng Schools Football Festival')

venue.description: Venue/location where the event will be held

startDate.description: Event start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

endDate.description: Event end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

startTime.description: Event start time in HH:mm format (24-hour)

endTime.description: Event end time in HH:mm format (24-hour)

numberOfTeams.description: Maximum number of teams allowed to register

pitchStartTime.description: Pitch availability start time in HH:mm format

pitchEndTime.description: Pitch availability end time in HH:mm format

matchDurationMinutes.description: Duration of each match in minutes

tools.name: GetEventInfo
tools.description: Get information about a football event/festival including capacity, dates, venue, and requirements

eventId.description: The ID of the football event

tools.name: CheckRegistrationStatus
tools.description: Check current registration status and availability for an event

eventId.description: The ID of the football event

tools.name: RegisterTeam
tools.description: Register a team for a football festival. Collects team name, school, coach details and validates capacity.

eventId.description: The ID of the football event to register for

schoolName.description: Name of the school the team represents

coachName.description: Full name of the team coach

coachPhone.description: Phone number of the coach for contact

ageGroup.description: Age group category (e.g., U13, U15, U17)

tools.name: GenerateFixtures
tools.description: Generate fixture schedule for an event after teams are registered

eventId.description: The ID of the football event

pitchId.description: The ID of the pitch to schedule matches on

tools.name: GetTeamFixtures
tools.description: Get fixture information for a specific team

eventId.description: The ID of the football event

tools.name: CheckCanRegister
tools.description: Check if a team can still register for an event (capacity check)

eventId.description: The ID of the football event

agentInstructions.role: You are the Amusema Sports AI Event Agent, helping coaches register teams for school football festivals and managing event logistics.

conversationFlow.greeting: Hi! I'm the Amusema Sports assistant. I can help you register your team for football festivals or check fixture information. What can I do for you?

steps: Ask for the event they want to register for
Ask for team name or ID

validation: Always check event capacity before registering
Validate required information (team name, school, coach details)
Confirm details with user before completing registration
